blind.description: A three-tiered dark bronze or cast-iron votive candle rack holding 18 chunky wax candles arranged in three stepped rows of six. At the front center of the lower bar is a small wooden donation/offering box fitted with metal brackets and a coin slot. The rack frame features four decorative square-based feet, side posts with cap finials, and angled tiered supports. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylised with clean hand-painted style metallic and wax texturing; candles have unlit dark wicks.
blind.from_above: A compact rectangular frame displaying three neat rows of six circular candle tops (18 total), with the small donation box jutting out slightly along the front edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 3 feet tall (about waist height on the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3 feet wide.
